result.summary: IMPLEMENTED per design sections 3, 4, 5, 6, 11. Records: create/update/delete_record/3 with head guard `is_binary(prefix) and is_authority(authority)`; /2 = one-line delegate with :tenant; private check_write_authority/3 (@spec, delegates to ManagedTypes.check_record_write/3) placed immediately after fetch_active_definition in all three with-chains (before validate_field_values / ensure_mutable); command_error gains {:error, :entity_type_managed}; each @doc gains the Step 1a paragraph; moduledoc 'Managed types (GH #2583)'. Import is `import Letflow.Entities.ManagedTypes, only: [is_authority: 1]` (fully qualified form, allowed by R1b; placed beside the Ecto.Query import), so T-18 must accept the qualified spelling. Router: render_record_command(:entity_type_managed) -> Error.entity_type_managed() before the catch-alls, mapping-comment row added; import_reason_json(:entity_type_managed) -> %{"type" => "entity_type_managed"} before the catch-all.
